status: design-only: nothing in this manifest is bundled yet; the Linux host/app packaging tasks consume it

layout.pythonEnv: .venv/ created at install time inside the tool directory (never system Python)
layout.openmvs: openmvs/ directory containing InterfaceCOLMAP, DensifyPointCloud, ReconstructMesh (SCAN_TO_MAKE_OPENMVS_DIR)

env.SCAN_TO_MAKE_COLMAP: <prefix>/bin/colmap (only when not using the distro package)

components.name: COLMAP
components.role: CPU sparse reconstruction (feature_extractor, matchers, mapper, image_undistorter, model_converter)
components.licence: BSD 3-Clause (COLMAP) — ship COPYING; bundled libraries keep their own notices (see COLMAP's license file)
components.acquire: Prefer the distro/apt package where available. A bundled build must be the CPU build (the tool always passes --SiftExtraction.use_gpu 0); CUDA is never required.

components.name: OpenMVS
components.role: Dense point cloud + mesh (InterfaceCOLMAP, DensifyPointCloud, ReconstructMesh), invoked as separate processes
components.licence: AGPL-3.0 — distributing these binaries obliges a written source offer for OpenMVS 2.4.0 exactly as built; ship the AGPL text and the offer. Process separation does not remove the binary-distribution duties.
components.acquire: Build from the pinned archive on the target distro (CMake, -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release); record the compiler and full flag set in the build receipt so the source offer is exact. Dependencies (Boost, Eigen, OpenCV, CGAL, etc.) come from the distro; list their package versions in the receipt.

components.name: Python
components.role: Runs the tool (stdlib plus usd-core only)
components.acquire: System interpreter to create .venv; the tool runs from .venv/bin/python via the launcher. Never install into the system interpreter (PEP 668).

components.name: usd-core (PyPI)
components.role: USDZ write/validate (export) and USDZ read (qualify of Apple output)
components.licence: Apache-2.0 (OpenUSD) — ship license in the venv as installed
components.acquire: pip install -r requirements.txt into .venv at install time (wheel; no compiler needed)

components.name: Pillow
components.role: NOT used by linux-reconstruct. Required by companion photo helpers (photo_overview.py, ai_tweak_stills.py) which run under the companion's Python, so it belongs in the companion payload manifest, not this tool's venv. Listed here so the combined installer does not double-count or omit it.
components.acquire: Owned by the companion/host packaging scope, not this manifest's installer steps.

installerSteps: Place COLMAP: distro package, or the pinned CPU build at bin/colmap.

Build OpenMVS 2.4.0 from the pinned archive; copy InterfaceCOLMAP, DensifyPointCloud, ReconstructMesh (+ RefineMesh/TextureMesh if later needed) into openmvs/; keep the source tree or a written offer per AGPL-3.0.
Write the launcher env (SCAN_TO_MAKE_LINUX_RECONSTRUCT / SCAN_TO_MAKE_OPENMVS_DIR / SCAN_TO_MAKE_COLMAP) into the host's service environment.
Run the smoke checks in verification; record a receipt (component versions, build flags, distro, uname) beside the payload.
Confirm capabilities.reconstructionReviewV1 reports true only after the smoke checks pass; do not advertise the capability from file presence alone in release packaging.
verification: linux-reconstruct samples <fixture photos> /tmp/smoke.usdz full --save-masks /tmp/smoke-masks --work-dir /tmp/smoke-work  (expect exit 5 needs-object-region with a preview STL)
updatePolicy: Versions above are pinned. Bump one component at a time, rerun verification, and record the change in this manifest in the same commit.
notBundledYet: No COLMAP or OpenMVS binaries in this repository
